name: spec_repetitive
description: Repetitive/templated decode for spec-PLD measurement. PLD shines when the model repeats recent n-grams (lists, JSON arrays, templated outputs).

prompts.text:
Generate a numbered list of 30 fruits, one per line, in the exact format '<number>. <fruit>': 1. apple
2. banana
3. cherry
4. date
5. elderberry
6. fig
7. grape
8. honeydew
9. imbe
10. jackfruit
11.
